fn main() -> Void {
    base = temperature_point(20.0, "degC")
    shifted = base + 0.3 K
    print(shifted)
    print(temperature_point_to(shifted, "degF"))
    print(temperature_point_to(shifted, "K"))
    body = temperature_point(98.6, "degF")
    print(temperature_point_to(body, "degC"))
    print(temperature_point_to(body, "K"))
    print(temperature_point_to(temperature_point(-40.0, "degC"), "degF"))
    print(temperature_point(36.6, "degC") - temperature_point(36.0, "degC"))
    print(temperature_point(100.0, "degF") > temperature_point(37.0, "degC"))
    print(temperature_point(20.3, "degC") == shifted)
    print(temperature_point(68.0, "degF") == temperature_point(20.0, "degC"))
}
